shared_elements: round-topped (arched) stele field with a lunette motif at top
human figures in profile with one arm extended forward
columns of small incised sign-writing (hieroglyph-like script)
disc or sun-disc motif in the upper area
horizontal dividing line separating an upper scene from a lower register
figures facing one another across the central table
staff/sceptre-like object held by a figure
justification: Both show the same distinctive scheme: an arched panel whose upper zone holds profile human figures facing each other across a laden offering stand, with vertical columns of small incised script between and above them, a disc motif in the lunette, and a ruled line separating a subsidiary lower register. The main differences in depicted content are that A's principal figures are seated with a dense lower register of smaller kneeling/seated attendants, whereas B's are standing, one wearing a horned/disc headdress, with an essentially empty lower band.
